ExtractionTier.description:
How far an observation sits from the bytes on the storage device.

Six graded tiers, lettered A to F, plus two states that are not points on the
ladder at all. ``INACCESSIBLE`` and ``NOT_EXAMINED`` record that the ladder
was never climbed. Treating them as a seventh and eighth rung would make "we
could not read it" look like a weak reading.
ExtractionTier.title: ExtractionTier

IdentityScope.description: How much of an entry an identity method read.
IdentityScope.title: IdentityScope

LocatorStep.description:
One step into the interior of a file.

A locator step says how to get from a container to something inside it. A
chain of them addresses a stream at any depth: the third sheet of a workbook
inside a zip archive is two steps.
LocatorStep.title: LocatorStep

SourceScope.description: Where in an entry a component or observation came from.
SourceScope.title: SourceScope

ValueKind.description:
The type of an observation's value.

An observation's value is stored in a typed column chosen by this
discriminator rather than stringified into one. Columnar storage rewards
that, and it keeps a numeric comparison from silently becoming a string
comparison.
ValueKind.title: ValueKind

description:
Something read from storage. Immutable, and never revised.

An observation's only claim is that a named observer, at a named version,
read this from this location at this time. A later scan produces a *new*
observation and both are kept, because the difference between two readings is
itself evidence.

Carries ``extraction_tier``, which measures distance from the bytes. It never
carries an inference tier: an observation is not a conclusion, and the two
axes are kept apart by keeping the models apart.
title: Observation
